summary: Implementation plan for SnipMD: a dual-mode Tauri v2 (Rust) and Web-compatible frameless Markdown note-taking application with Vanilla TypeScript, CodeMirror 6 inline screenshot block widgets, atomic collision-free snip naming, scratchpad promotion with mark-and-sweep orphan garbage collection, hot-exit session persistence, and a built-in Snip Simulator for browser testing.
